title: fix(charts): ten distinct theme chart colours so a 6-10 slice pie never repeats a colour
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNgJrQDxaUNx2so1ektgf6A)_

Fixes #34902

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfrh8TiPJf1i2kMSoa

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：主题新增 `--chart-6` 到 `--chart-10` 五个图表色（亮色与暗色两套，组件库与控制台两份样式表，含 `--color-chart-N` 别名）；图表默认调色板与仪表盘两处默认调色板从 5 色改为读取全部 10 色；`objectui` CLI 生成的应用样式表同步带上这 10 个色值；`responsiveStyles` 样式检查把 `chart-6` 到 `chart-10` 认作已知令牌。
- **为什么改**：默认调色板只有 5 色并按序循环，6 个及以上扇区的饼图/环形图第 1 与第 6 片同色，图例无法区分（HotCRM 销售仪表盘实测）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只增加主题变量与调色板条目，前 5 色不变；作者在元数据里写的 `colors` 仍优先。可见变化仅限第 6 类及以后的颜色。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/components/src/index.css`（新色值，生成器与之逐值对齐）、`ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`（`THEME_CHART_PALETTE` 与 `getPalette`）、`ui/packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts`（生成应用的 `--chart-N` 与别名）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.colors.test.tsx packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardChart.chartConfigMarks-4044.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件全部通过（37 passed）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Theme tokens.** `--chart-6` to `--chart-10` are added in light and dark, beside `--chart-1..5`, in both theme stylesheets (`@object-ui/components` and the Console). Each stylesheet also gets the matching `--color-chart-6..10` aliases. The new values resolve against the token palette, and no raw colour is inlined in TS (ADR-0065 §3).
- **Fallback palettes.** `AdvancedChartImpl`'s `getPalette()` falls back to a module constant, `THEME_CHART_PALETTE`, which holds `hsl(var(--chart-1))` to `hsl(var(--chart-10))`. The dashboard relays' `CHART_COLORS` in `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` carry the same ten entries. plugin-charts is only a devDependency of plugin-dashboard, so the claimed packages have no shared runtime home for these lists. The three lists are kept in step, and comments point at each other.
- The authored `colors` prop still wins over the default, and `categoryColors` still wins per category. The spec and the chart schema are unchanged.
- **Generated apps (`@object-ui/cli`).** `app-generator.ts` emits `--chart-1..10` in `:root` and `.dark` with the same values as `@object-ui/components`, plus `--color-chart-6..10`. The CLI ships without the library stylesheet, so reading it at generation time is not cheap. The values are kept in step instead, and a new test compares them value by value against `packages/components/src/index.css`.
- **Style lint (`@objectstack/lint`).** In `validate-responsive-styles.ts`, the known-token list now runs to `chart-10`. The list only spells the bare `chart-N` form, so it has no alias form to add.
- One patch changeset covers the six touched packages.

### Hue choice

The five new hues fill the gaps that the existing `--chart-1..5` leave: green, magenta/plum, cyan, deep red and a low-saturation slate. Tableau 10 uses the same approach: it adds a neutral as the tenth colour, so the last slot differs by saturation rather than by hue. The same hue family is used in all four blocks. Saturation and lightness are tuned for each block against its own `--chart-1..5` and its own background.

| Token | components light | components dark | console light | console dark |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `--chart-6` (green) | `130 55% 40%` | `115 55% 48%` | `135 60% 36%` | `135 60% 46%` |
| `--chart-7` (magenta) | `315 65% 38%` | `300 55% 72%` | `315 70% 34%` | `315 55% 48%` |
| `--chart-8` (cyan) | `195 85% 48%` | `187 65% 48%` | `192 80% 42%` | `192 80% 52%` |
| `--chart-9` (red) | `0 70% 38%` | `0 70% 46%` | `0 70% 36%` | `0 70% 48%` |
| `--chart-10` (slate) | `215 14% 55%` | `210 12% 60%` | `215 14% 58%` | `210 12% 68%` |

How the values were measured: CIEDE2000 between each new colour and its nearest neighbour among all ten in the same block, computed with an ad-hoc script that is not committed.

- components light: 19.7 / 27.7 / 19.2 / 24.9 / 19.2
- components dark: 15.2 / 17.3 / 19.1 / 18.8 / 18.9
- console light: 18.9 / 20.8 / 16.9 / 22.8 / 16.9
- console dark: 21.2 / 17.2 / 18.5 / 23.9 / 18.5

The lowest pair inside the existing `--chart-1..5` measures 15.9, 22.6, 15.0 and 13.1 in the same four blocks, so every new colour is at least as distinct as the existing palette already is. Contrast against the theme background (white or `222.2 84% 4.9%`) is 2.56 to 8.10 in light and 3.53 to 9.23 in dark. The existing light entries go as low as 1.67.

## Tests

Measured at head `5d3cef01d`, which merges `origin/main` `fff0ad0c1` onto the branch. The incoming commits touch none of plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard or the two stylesheets. The dependency closure was built first and rebuilt after the merge: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-charts^...' build` (VERDICT command-exit 0).

- `AdvancedChartImpl.colors.test.tsx`, the shared colours harness, gets a new top-level `describe` with seven tests:
  - a donut with 6, 7, 8, 9 or 10 slices and no `colors` draws fills equal to `hsl(var(--chart-1..N))`, all distinct;
  - a 10-slice pie no longer gives slice 6 the colour of slice 1;
  - CONTROL: an authored `colors` prop still wins and cycles.
- `DashboardChart.chartConfigMarks-4044.test.tsx`, the dashboard-surface marks harness, gets a new top-level `describe.each` over both relays (`grid`, `renderer`). Without `chartConfig`, a 6-slice and a 10-slice pie draw the ten theme colours in order, all distinct. CONTROL: an authored array `colors` still wins over the ten-colour default. The `renderWidget` helper gained an optional `rows` argument that defaults to the existing rows.
- `ChartRenderer.catalogRender-6939.test.tsx` was re-pinned, which this change made necessary. The renderer emits two `linearGradient` defs for each palette entry, so the census grows by +10 gradients, +20 stops and +30 elements for each fixture. The text SHA-256, the line, area and tick counts are unchanged. The pin's comment records the re-measure.
- `packages/plugin-charts/` + `packages/plugin-dashboard/` at the pre-merge head: Test Files 308 passed and 1 failed (309), Tests 3364 passed, 2 failed and 15 skipped. The 2 failures were the catalog census above, which was then re-pinned. After the merge, the three touched files give Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 42 passed (42).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` exit 0, and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` exit 0. Both run `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
- ESLint on the five changed TS files, run with the packages' own `eslint`, reports 0 errors. Every warning is a pre-existing `no-explicit-any` or `no-unused-vars` on lines this diff does not touch.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the tests import src by relative path, so there is no dist leg)</summary>

Each ablation deletes the five `--chart-6..10` entries from one palette and runs the harness for that palette.

- Fold round (claim amendment 6958535269), measured at head `8047d3552`:
  - `app-generator.test.ts` gets a new top-level `describe`. Both generator shapes declare `--chart-1..10` in light and dark, equal to the library's values, and the library itself carries all ten in both themes. `--color-chart-6..10` map through the declared variables. Result: 50 passed (50).
  - The existing pin `declares every theme token the component library declares` was red on CI at `5d3cef01d`: Test UI shard 2/16 expected 39 tokens and got 34. The aliases fix it.
  - `validate-responsive-styles.test.ts` gets a new top-level `describe`. `chart-6` to `chart-10` raise no `style-unknown-token`. CONTROL: `chart-11` raises exactly one. Result: 15 passed (15).
  - Full suites: `@objectstack/lint` gave Test Files 217 passed (217), Tests 9192 passed (9192). `packages/cli/` under `ui/` gave Test Files 31 passed (31), Tests 422 passed (422).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check` both exit 0.
  - ESLint on the four changed files: 0 errors.

```
C lint chart-6..10 removed:                 5 failed | 10 passed (15)  -> accepts chart-6..10; CONTROL chart-11 stays green
each: ok restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- File surface beyond the claim: `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.catalogRender-6939.test.tsx`. This change made its census stale, so it was re-pinned here rather than left red.
- The two five-token lists found in the first round, `app-generator.ts` and `validate-responsive-styles.ts`, are folded in here by claim amendment 6958535269.
- The first round did not run the `ui/packages/cli` suite, so I missed locally that the existing token-parity pin went red. CI caught it, and this round fixes it.
- I did not check the change in a real browser. The tests read the drawn Recharts sector fills, and the token values come from the stylesheets.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `8047d3552`: 69 derived families, and all 69 exited 0. In the batch run, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3. Re-run alone, it exited 0: 124 entry points across 72 packages load. The `--ran` reconciliation, with exit codes recorded, reported 69 run and 0 NOT-MEASURED. At `5d3cef01d` the derivation was 40 families, all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: 0 anchored files in the change set, at both heads.
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-34902-chart-palette-ten` ran before each push. The verdict was clean, exit 0, merging cleanly with `origin/main`.
- CI at `5d3cef01d`: Test UI went red (shard 2/16, the token-parity pin above). CI at `8047d3552` had not concluded when this body was written.
